title: Pressure
content: Pressure is defined as the force exerted normally on unit area.
e: Pressure is defined as the force exerted normally on unit area. Pressure is force acting normally on unit area. The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure.

title: Density
content: Density is the ratio of mass to volume of a substance.
e: Density is the ratio of mass to volume of a substance. Density is mass per unit volume. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

title: Relative Density
content: Relative density is the ratio of the density of a substance to the density of water at 4 degrees Celsius.
e: Relative density is the ratio of the density of a substance to the density of water at 4 degrees Celsius. Relative Density is mass per unit volume. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

title: Hydrometer
content: Hydrometer is an instrument for measuring the density or relative density of liquids.
e: Hydrometer is an instrument for measuring the density or relative density of liquids. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.
